title: interaction.logged payload v1
description: Payload schema for event_type interaction.logged, schema_version 1, carried in the payload field of event-envelope.v1. Mirrors the atomic log-interaction write set (database-contract.md section 2 / domain-model.md section 4): the interaction, the mandatory next-action task, and their linkage. Deliberately excludes the free-text note (sensitive CRM content stays out of the event stream; PostgreSQL is authoritative for timeline reads). interaction_id equals the envelope aggregate_id; tenant_id equals the envelope tenant_id; actor_user_id equals the envelope actor_id; occurred_at equals the envelope occurred_at. The outcome enum mirrors Node P's closed vocabulary (product-behavior.md section 1); a vocabulary change requires a new payload schema version. Contract: docs/specs/event-contract.md.

interaction_id.description: The created interaction's id. Equals the envelope's aggregate_id.

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant. Equals the envelope's tenant_id.

contact_id.description: The contact the interaction was logged against (same tenant).

company_id.description: The contact's owning company at logging time (same tenant).

kind.description: Interaction kind; only call exists in this slice.

outcome.description: Stable outcome token from Node P's closed vocabulary. Tokens are stable even when visible labels change; labels are Node P's.

next_action_date.description: The required next-action date (task.due_on), a calendar date interpreted in the tenant's operating timezone.

task_id.description: The mandatory next-action task created atomically with the interaction.

actor_user_id.description: user_id of the acting user who logged the interaction. Equals the envelope's actor_id.

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC server-assigned interaction.occurred_at. Equals the envelope's occurred_at.
